issues.desc: CHK-001 currently states an internal refactor (extracting canonical binding derivation) but does not state a user-observable outcome. Make completion recognizable by requiring that a degraded single-host submission and quorum submission produce the same canonical binding values for the same evidence, with no behavior regression in quorum.
